headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $76,000 Following Tech Selloff and ETF Outflows
summary: Bitcoin recovered above the $76,000 level on Friday after dropping below it during Thursday's technology-driven market decline. The move occurred as spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $430 million in net outflows.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital asset by market capitalization and serves as a benchmark for the broader cryptocurrency market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 following a dip caused by a technology market selloff and ETF outflows.
